question: Who among the following Gupta rulers married a girl from the Lichchhavi clan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta-l.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chandragupta I is said to be started a new Gupta Era, which starts on the 26th February 320 AD, which is known as the coronation date of Chandragupta I. 
 
• He greatly raised the power and prestige of his dynasty through his matrimonial relations and conquests.
 
• He was married to the lichchhavi princess Kumara Devi.
 
• She was the first Indian queen to be featured on the coin.
 
• He established his authority over Magadha, Saketa and Prayaga.
 
• He was the first Gupta king to adopt the title of Maharajadhiraja. 
 
• He issued a gold coin and increased the power and prestige of the empire to a great extent. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Gupta empire was founded by Sri Gupta. 
 
• The Gupta Empire rose in Magadha around the 4th century AD and covered the greater part of Northern India.
 
• The Gupta Period is popularly known as the ‘Golden Age of India’.
 
• There is very little information about the first two rulers of the Gupta dynasty.
 
• The important rulers of the Gupta dynasty were:
 
 
• Chandragupta I - (320 - 330 A.D.)
 
• Samudragupta - (330 - 380 A.D.)
 
• Chandragupta II - (380 - 415 A.D.)
 
• Kumaragupta - (415 - 455 A.D.)
